jp_sentences: 今日は学校がやすみでした。
あさは、テレビを見たり、そうじをしたりしました。
午後は母といっしょにデパートへ行きました。
そこで、かばんを見たり、コーヒーをのんだりしました。
jp: 今日は学校がやすみでした。あさは、テレビを見たり、そうじをしたりしました。午後は母といっしょにデパートへ行きました。そこで、かばんを見たり、コーヒーをのんだりしました。たのしい一日でした。
translation_pt: Hoje não teve aula. De manhã, fiquei vendo televisão, arrumando a casa, essas coisas. À tarde, fui com a minha mãe até a loja de departamentos. Lá a gente ficou olhando bolsas, tomando café. Foi um dia gostoso.
translation_pt_sentences: De manhã, fiquei vendo televisão, arrumando a casa, essas coisas.
À tarde, fui com a minha mãe até a loja de departamentos.
Lá a gente ficou olhando bolsas, tomando café.
translation_en: There was no school today. In the morning I watched TV, tidied up the house, and things like that. In the afternoon I went to the department store with my mother. There we looked at bags, had some coffee, and so on. It was a nice day.
translation_en_sentences: In the morning I watched TV, tidied up the house, and things like that.
In the afternoon I went to the department store with my mother.
There we looked at bags, had some coffee, and so on.
